title: Describe the requested design
responsibility: Builds a product-design prompt with Harness styling and the selected thread’s visual context.

inputs.name: designPrompt.context
inputs.description: The entity title and requested thread identity. A matching thread supplies state, viewport and optional region; defaults are default state, desktop viewport and the whole image.

inputs.name: designPrompt.prompt
inputs.description: The proposal or feedback to append unchanged after the design instructions.

outputs.name: designPrompt
outputs.description: A prompt describing the navy-and-gold Harness interface, control placement, entity, state and viewport. When a reference image is attached by the caller, it asks for revisions focused on the thread’s region while preserving other design decisions. The helper generates text only.
